label: Capella Management API
type: the REST API surface for managing clusters/organizations/projects/etc. - parallel to capella:data-api but management-plane rather than data-plane
note: Consolidates two independent mints of the same real surface: 'capella:management-api' (most files) and 'api:management-api' (one batch). Authenticates via mgmt-api:api-key (Bearer-token API keys), a genuinely different credential from the Data API's reuse of the ordinary cluster-access-credential-type Basic-auth model - confirmed by this wave's data-api-guide batch reading both surfaces' docs firsthand.
